First immutable decision timestamps use actual supplied bundle boundary/current synthetic owner time. After committing the first decision, exact retry preserves original timestamps/bytes and cannot calculate a fresh decision against changed time/context. Logical key run+identity/content+boundary; commitments are immutable payload, not new key suffixes.

Persist decision batch and actual E5 RISK_DECISION/APPROVED_TRADE_PLAN before original claim. service.execute remains actual last effect guard and actual FakeProductProvider.request enforces current RuntimeAdmission; exact retry uses service existing claim->GET order/fills readback, not another POST.
The single test observes both real claim calls (original and retry); pendingACK atfirstclock then OPEN0fill at+1second must produce ACK_PENDING then ORDER_OBSERVED. No fill/flat/trade is inferred.

After actual fixture approval revoke, saved decision stays readable unchanged but evaluate_entry must not bypass actual fresh current authority (RuntimeAdmissionError; zero additional FakeProductProvider calls). Historical decision read does not itself issue/return an opaque permit.
test_assertion_boundaries: Exact registered strategy id/version/content and true AsOfBundle boundary/cutoff/final bar; actual E2 LONG and actual E5 APPROVE oracle.
Canonical store starts with no risk or approved plan for actual computed plan ID; accepted outputs are not preinstalled by helper.

Passive delegating claim spy sees actual immutable E6-local E2 decision and exact original canonical E5 risk+plan BEFORE original claim commit; passive provider spy sees actual committed READBACK_REQUIRED claim and same canonical outputs BEFORE actual guarded POST.

Exact retry preserves typed decision snapshot/ID, requestID, RiskDecision/ApprovedTradePlan bytes/hash and one canonical OrderRequest; actual provider call sequence POST/GET/GET, one POST total, zero fills and no TradeResult.
Revocation cannot mint a new actual NEW_EXPOSURE permit or create provider effect from saved decision; immutable historical decision remains equal.
instrumentation: patch.object spies only assert then forward the original bound claim_dispatch/FakeProductProvider.request. They do not substitute results, owner factories, risk/evaluator outputs, permits, clock factories, database state, network or authority.
